name: bf-investment-income
description: Burkina Faso investment income and IRCM withholding workpaper for the 2026 tax year. Use for individual investors receiving dividends, deposit or loan interest, associates receiving company advances, and companies or intermediaries preparing the related withholding records. It separates ordinary receivables from securities and company borrowings, tests the new-company distribution reduction, and states selected savings, public-debt, director and redistribution exemptions with their conditions. The Guide covers gross bases, payment and account-entry tax points, different return and remittance calendars, information reports and statutory sanctions. It provides executable classification and distribution cases. Treaty entitlement, personal foreign-income classification, special exemptions and authenticated filing remain explicit gaps; this is source-cited preparation without accountant attestation.
